description: This file defines a REST API controller class 'VersionAPI' for handling requests related to the version information of the installer upgrade process in the OrangeHRM project. It inherits from an abstract controller and implements a method to retrieve version data, optionally excluding the latest version.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for retrieving version information related to the installer upgrader.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve version list, optionally excluding the latest version.
